# Separate eight-reader cohort

This packet adds exactly 12 new cases: 8 readers, four map implementations, and three fresh processes per implementation. It does not repeat, replace, or pool the existing 36 cases from run 38109729237 at source 8ad5788648db93c18994fdde9b8fdb12e3a4957b. The existing zero/two/four-reader full-matrix definition remains exact. The additional recording type is `eight-reader-cohort`, with 12 cases and 20 stage groups. Other subsets remain diagnostics.

The workload remains 100,000 JSON feature records with 20% Unicode names, 1,000 sparse queries with 910 hits and 90 misses, 100 replacements per revision, initial/current retained roots, released initial roots, and ten further updates. Eight readers perform four copies each of the lookup and validation tasks. All answers, publication counts, sparse clone counts, and cleanup checks remain mandatory. No benefit threshold is imposed.

The reference file pins the original manifest's runtime, dependencies, complete staged module hashes, proof hashes, source commit and summary/terminal digests. Before calibration or cases, the new driver requires identical built library, feature adapter and dependency bytes, Node/V8 version, platform and architecture. Existing workload, calibration, worker, case and reference proof files must retain their hashes. Only the model's accepted cohort/classification and the driver's cohort/provenance checks change. The source diff must prove the memory accounting functions unchanged.

The hosted run builds from its own exact commit and records that commit, CPU, OS, runtime, dependency versions and timestamps. It also records the original cohort reference separately. Even if machine metadata matches, new results retain separate cohort provenance. Public eight-reader percentages compare libraries only within this new cohort; old two/four-reader percentages continue to use only the original cohort. No unmeasured value is extrapolated.

The one temporary workflow triggers only on `validation/sharedmap-eight-readers-20261011`, attempt 1, with read-only repository permissions. It has one recording job and no site build, browser, chart import, deployment or PR publication. Official Node 22.23.3 and Bun 1.4.2 setup are unchanged. Read-only headroom preflight precedes expensive setup. Working bytes are checked against HEAD before and after the build; 112 root runtime source files must equal main d856ff0bd41745ae0e84d9d726d6aaaf7013fc25.

Resource controls remain unchanged: 20-minute whole recording limit, 2 GiB process-group RSS ceiling, 256 MiB combined evidence ceiling, 3 GiB effective preflight headroom and 1 GiB reserve, 500 ms observations and 5-second cleanup verification. Effective availability is the minimum of host and observable ancestor-cgroup headroom. The reviewed v2 root proof and fail-closed behavior are unchanged. Individual calibration, RPC and case limits remain 60/60/180 seconds. The 30-minute job limit includes setup. Prior four-reader results do not guarantee the eight-reader cohort fits. Any cap, incomplete run, inaccessible guard or mismatch leaves all partial evidence intact and chart-ineligible; no rerun or cap relaxation is implied.

Before activation, independently review exact source and pins, then release one bounded local pure gate (cohort fixtures, parser and whitespace only). Separately review the publication tree and release one branch activation. Import and display only after artifact/source/accounting review confirms a complete valid 12-case cohort. Existing measurements and failed/local/denied attempts remain unchanged.
